contrary_evidence: US S&P 500 and European STOXX 600 advanced while Brazil declined, weakening a global indiscriminate risk-off thesis.
US nominal and real ten-year Treasury yields were unchanged on 23 versus 26 October, limiting a new global rate-shock explanation.
Brazilian PTAX and Reuters spot differ by instrument and observation window; no capital-outflow volume was verified.
An auction cancellation alone does not demonstrate impaired sovereign debt service or prolonged market illiquidity.
Reported HSBC portfolio view is not independently confirmed by the original house-view note and does not prove actual capital reallocations.
limitations: Brazilian five-year CDS and spot USD/BRL values are attributed Reuters market quotes rather than primary exchange fixing series.
Original full HSBC house-view and primary Brazilian Treasury cancellation notice were not independently obtained; the latter was corroborated by multiple reports quoting the official notice.
CI strict all-pending depth gate fails on pre-existing rejected drafts; the candidate itself meets its effective gates. No local checkout was available to run Node directly.
No 27 October cash-session quotation is asserted; 26 October completed sessions are the information cutoff.
notes: Independent QA 4/5; source 3/3 SHAs verified on current HEAD. This approval is an immutable snapshot for publisher 5/5. No public files changed.
